description: This file contains interface and class definitions related to the serialization of MemoryMessageBody objects used in Orleans stream providers, including a default serializer implementation, the MemoryMessageBody class itself, and related attributes.

classes.name: DefaultMemoryMessageBodySerializer
classes.description: Default implementation of IMemoryMessageBodySerializer, handles serialization and deserialization of MemoryMessageBody objects, with lazy service provider injection for serializer field.

classes.name: MemoryMessageBody
classes.description: Represents the message body used in in-memory streams within Orleans, containing events and request context data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a MemoryMessageBody object into a byte array segment.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array segment into a MemoryMessageBody object.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Callback invoked upon deserialization to restore the serializer instance from the service provider.

methods.name: MemoryMessageBody
methods.description: Constructor initializes MemoryMessageBody with events and request context.
